articles.title: MetaMask launches Money Account with stablecoin yield and spending in one wallet
articles.snippet: The launch reflects a broader push to make stablecoins more useful beyond trading and transfers.

articles.title: Securitize heads to NYSE debut after investors approve SPAC merger
articles.snippet: The tokenization firm is expected to begin trading on the NYSE on Thursday, becoming one of the first publicly traded pure-play tokenization companies.

articles.title: Cathie Wood’s ARK adds $43.5M in crypto stocks amid market dip
articles.snippet: ARK Invest's biggest crypto stock purchases over the past three trading days were Coinbase and Circle, whose shares have fallen 17% and 27.6%, respectively, over the past month.

articles.title: SEC wins $5.4M judgment in NanoBit crypto fraud case
articles.snippet: The SEC alleged that NanoBit’s crypto trading platform was fake and that hundreds of thousands of dollars in investor funds were misappropriated.

articles.title: Crypto Wallet MetaMask Launches Yield-Paying Money Account on Monad
articles.snippet: MetaMask is packaging stablecoin yield, payments, and trading into a single self-custody account as crypto firms compete to make digital dollars more useful.
